prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / focused portrait revision.
Input 1 is the first-pass portrait EDIT TARGET. Input 2 is original selected identity reference. Inputs 3–5 are style-only anchors. Keep the same person, age, sex, face proportions, angle and clothing colors. A single tight 74 x 100 logical-pixel medieval RPG dialogue HEAD. All hair, ears and collar fully contained with at least 2 logical pixels transparent side margin and 3 above. Full raw canvas will be fitted aspect-preservingly inside 72x98 on 74x100; do not clip raw content.
Hard broad low-resolution pixel clusters, 4–6 skin planes, maximum 32 muted colors, large clear nose/cheek/jaw anatomy and deliberate stepped edges. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. No antialiasing, gradients, dithering, soft painting, hatching, microtexture or scattered accent pixels. No props, hands, shoulders, text, frame or extra people. An actual redraw, not merely crop/resize. Final technical NN and palette export is a disclosed non-native derivative.
SORE: ADULT WOMAN in her TWENTIES, same brown side-part compact-bun fitting apprentice with broad cheekbones/definite chin, ochre blouse and brown apron-strap edge. Preserve face identity, gender, age, warm muted palette. No wound, new scar, bandage, arm, hand, prosthesis or healed-state signal.
Essential expression change: REMOVE worried central forehead peak and vertical furrow entirely. LOWER INNER eyebrow ends to form two almost HORIZONTAL compact brows. One OUTER end may press down very slightly. Level-eyed focused scrutiny and professional self-possession. No grief, fear, pain, angry villain scowl, worried V or pity.
Redraw conspicuous pout as a SMALL FLAT CLOSED mouth with slight asymmetric offset, no enlarged lower lip. Firm matter-of-fact technical attention.
Dark compact pupils with very narrow DIM gray-tan sclera slivers. No white blocks or sparkles.
Pull ALL long curled dangling strands back into compact rear bun. Replace cheek-side curls with TWO SHORT WIDE temple wedges ending above jaw. Merge parallel striped locks into FOUR broad connected asymmetric brown masses with few hard edges. Bun fully contained with visible margin, no curls, rings or streaks.
Very short almost hidden neck and thin ochre/brown collar at bottom 5–7%, no shoulders/chest. Full hair and ears contained. No sponsors, armor-gift display, injury performance or reconciliation.
